blocks.text: Tilbury Industrial Real Estate — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of industrial properties are located in Tilbury, Delta?

includes small-bay and mid-bay industrial strata units, freestanding distribution warehouses, cold-storage facilities, outdoor storage yards, and heavy manufacturing sites along River Road, Hopcott Road, and Progress Way.
What zoning applies to industrial properties in Tilbury?

Most parcels in Tilbury fall under City of Delta Industrial zones (such as Light Impact Industrial, Medium Impact Industrial, and Heavy Impact Industrial). Always verify the exact permitted uses, outdoor storage ratios, and parking requirements on
How does Tilbury connect to major highways and port terminals?

Tilbury sits immediately adjacent to Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road) and Highway 99, providing direct truck access to Deltaport at Roberts Bank, the US border at Peace Arch and Pacific Highway,
Are environmental site assessments required when buying Tilbury industrial real estate?

Yes. Commercial lenders in British Columbia almost always require a current Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) — and a Phase II ESA if historical manufacturing, fuel storage, or fill activity is flagged — before funding an industrial purchase in Tilbury.
What should buyers check in a Tilbury industrial strata complex?

Review two years of strata council minutes, the depreciation report, the Form B Information Certificate, floor-load ratings (pounds per square foot), 3-phase electrical service amperage, clear ceiling height, dock vs grade loading doors, and strata bylaws regarding automotive, food, or outdoor uses.
What geotechnical and floodplain rules apply to Tilbury industrial land?

Because Tilbury sits on the south arm of the Fraser River delta, new construction or major site expansion requires geotechnical preload engineering, dike/setback verification, and compliance with City of Delta Flood Construction Level (FCL) bylaws.
